statement: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva wins the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, either outright in the first round held on 2026-10-04 or in the runoff scheduled for 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if official Superior Electoral Court results at resultados.tse.jus.br show Lula elected: over 50 percent of valid votes on 2026-10-04, or the most valid votes in the 2026-10-25 runoff.
failure_condition: A candidate other than Lula is elected, or no deciding round has been completed by 2026-10-25.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Democrats and independents who caucus with them win enough seats in the US Senate elections of 2026-11-03, including any runoff held through 2026-12-01, to hold at least 51 seats in the Senate that convenes in January 2027.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls for the 2026-11-03 Senate elections, including any runoff through 2026-12-01, leave the Democratic caucus with 51 or more seats in the Senate convening January 2027.
failure_condition: The Democratic caucus is left with 50 or fewer seats in the incoming Senate once the 2026 races, including any runoff through 2026-12-01, are decided.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-10-28. Reference: target range of 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement of 2026-10-28 lifts the target range upper limit above 4.00 percent, so that FRED series DFEDTARU reads above 4.00 on 2026-10-29. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The upper limit of the federal funds target range is still 4.00 percent or lower after the 2026-10-28 decision.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The ICE Brent December 2026 crude futures contract settles at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 102.25 dollars on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any daily ICE settlement of the Brent December 2026 contract between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30 is 110.00 dollars or higher. Reference: 102.25 dollars, the prior-session close on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every daily settlement of the Brent December 2026 contract between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30 is below 110.00 dollars.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
